items.stem: In ServiceNow CSM, which record type represents an organisation you provide service to?

options.rationale: Correct: an account represents a customer organisation in the B2B model.
Incident is an ITSM record, not a CSM customer organisation.
A CI represents infrastructure, not a customer organisation.
A KB article is content, not a customer organisation.

items.stem: What determines whether a contact is eligible to receive a given level of support?

Business rules run logic; they are not the eligibility definition.
UI actions add buttons/links, not eligibility.
